note: IDs are append-only. Never renumber or reuse an ID; retire an entry with "retired": true and take the next ID from next_id for new entries. record_code: the code the island water record (tools/watershed/record.py, R6) writes for this class; water_record.gd maps it to this id, so tile files keep the table's ids. land: the cell is ground for the climate and land types (a wetland or a dry-season bed), and biome and soil (names) are given to it after them (water_record.gd land_view and apply_wet_land; docs/water/stage_e_readers_design.md 6c). fresh: perennial fresh water. well: a well or pump may reach down to this water (Sonny, 10 Nov 2026): lakes, rivers and the wetlands, whose table is at the surface; not the sea, the brackish estuary, the seasonal beds (dry part of the year, the table then lies below them) or the salt marsh. Kept apart from fresh, which feeds the fresh_m distance.
